_meta.indication: VANFLYTA is a kinase inhibitor indicated in combination with standard cytarabine and anthracycline induction and cytarabine consolidation, and as maintenance monotherapy following consolidation chemotherapy, for adult patients with newly diagnosed AML that is FLT3-ITD-positive as detected by an FDA-approved test.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized (1:1), double-blind, placebo-controlled study of VANFLYTA versus placebo, each in combination with standard cytarabine/anthracycline induction and cytarabine consolidation, and as maintenance monotherapy.
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients (ages 18-75) with newly diagnosed FLT3-ITD positive AML; median age 56 years.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Overall survival (OS), measured from date of randomization until death by any cause (primary endpoint).
pivotal_trials.result: Statistically significant improvement in OS: median OS 31.9 months (VANFLYTA) vs 15.1 months (placebo); HR 0.78 (95% CI 0.62, 0.98); 2-sided p=0.0324.

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (>20%, including lab abnormalities) include febrile neutropenia, diarrhea, mucositis, nausea, sepsis, neutropenia, headache. Serious adverse reaction in ≥5%: febrile neutropenia (11%). Fatal adverse reactions occurred in 10% of VANFLYTA patients, including sepsis (5%). QT prolongation was an important risk.
target_moa: Quizartinib is a small molecule inhibitor of the receptor tyrosine kinase FLT3; quizartinib and its active metabolite AC886 bind the ATP-binding domain of FLT3 and inhibit FLT3 kinase activity, preventing autophosphorylation.

boxed_warning.content: WARNING: QT PROLONGATION, TORSADES DE POINTES, and CARDIAC ARREST. VANFLYTA prolongs the QT interval; torsades de pointes and cardiac arrest have occurred. Contraindicated in patients with severe hypokalemia, severe hypomagnesemia, or long QT syndrome. Do not initiate or escalate if QTcF > 450 ms. Available only through the VANFLYTA REMS.

rems.type: VANFLYTA is available only through a restricted program called the VANFLYTA REMS, determined necessary to ensure the benefits outweigh the risks of QT prolongation, Torsades de Pointes, and cardiac arrest.

companion_dx_detail: LeukoStrat CDx FLT3 Mutation Assay, an FDA-approved test for selection of AML patients with FLT3-ITD mutation for VANFLYTA treatment.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee was convened for this NDA; instead, two Special Government Employees (SGEs) were consulted on Feb 27 and March 6, 2023, and both concluded quizartinib has a favorable benefit-risk profile for use with induction and consolidation chemotherapy, while noting concerns about post-HSCT maintenance benefit.

summary.text: VANFLYTA (quizartinib) received regular approval under a Priority review for newly diagnosed FLT3-ITD positive AML, based on a statistically significant OS improvement in the pivotal QuANTUM-First trial. It had Fast-track designation (granted March 2022) and Orphan Drug Designation for AML (granted 2009). Approval carried a boxed warning for QT prolongation, Torsades de Pointes and cardiac arrest, and a REMS.
